description: This file is a Go source code file implementing a command-line tool for translating documentation files. It includes functions for processing files sequentially and in parallel, managing translation jobs, loading glossaries and translation memories, and handling user-specified options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program; parses flags, initializes resources, and dispatches translation jobs based on mode.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes documentation files sequentially in the 'doc' mode, handling each file one by one.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes documentation files in parallel using multiple worker goroutines.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes segments in documents sequentially in 'segment' mode.

methods.name: resolveRelPath
methods.description: Resolves a relative path of a file within the documentation root.

methods.name: filterDocQueue
methods.description: Filters out documentation files that do not need translation based on content hashing and existing translations.
